name: Isolate — focal dim fixture
description: Proving fixture for the isolate Annotation (was dead-by-use — referenced by zero presets). One [isolate] focal passage in a plain-surface body; as the mark progresses the surrounding text dims toward the backgroundVisibility floor, isolating the focal sentence. Verifies the composition focal shader's isolate styleCode (4) path renders. On plain deliberately (2026-08-03): the isolate treatment is achromatic dimming, so its pack-diff evidence is the dimmed SURFACE responding to the pack — the substrate-immune paper (ADR-0039 §2) stopped re-skinning and left the row nothing to measure. Fixture — exercises the pipeline, not held to the R/Q/G deliverable floors.

content.body: Most of the system runs on conventions nobody wrote down. [isolate]The one rule that actually matters is that the build must stay green.[/isolate] Everything else is negotiable, and most of it gets renegotiated every quarter when a new team inherits the service.
